{{Short description|Taiwanese chemist (1933–2009)}}
'''Ying-Nan Chiu''' ({{zh|t=丘應楠}}; 1933–2009) was a Taiwanese chemist.

Chiu's father {{ill|Chiu Nian-tai|zh|丘念台}} and grandfather [[Chiu Feng-chia]] left Taiwan upon the collapse of the [[Republic of Formosa]]. Ying-Nan Chiu was educated in the United States, earning his bachelor's degree at [[Berea College]] in 1955, followed by a master's degree in 1956 and doctorate in 1960, both from [[Yale University]]. Chiu conducted postdoctoral research at [[Columbia University]] until 1962, then moved to the [[University of Chicago]]. He joined [[The Catholic University of America]] as an assistant professor in 1964, and spent the rest of his career there, advancing to an associate professorship in 1966, a full professorship in 1970, serving as chair of the chemistry department from 1972 to 1981, and retiring with emeritus status in 2001.<ref name="as">{{cite news |title=Ying-Nan Chiu 丘應楠 |url=https://academicians.sinica.edu.tw/index.php?r=academician-n%2Fshow&id=167 |access-date=11 November 2024 |publisher=Academia Sinica}}</ref><ref name="yam">{{cite news |title=Recent alumni deaths |url=https://www.yalealumnimagazine.com/articles/2884-recent-alumni-deaths |access-date=11 November 2024 |work=Yale Alumni Magazine |date=March–April 2010}}</ref>

Chiu was elected a fellow of the [[American Physical Society]] and a member of [[Academia Sinica]] in 1986.<ref name="as"/><ref name="apsfellowsearch">{{cite news |title=Honors and award winners |url=https://www.aps.org/funding-recognition/winners?award_recipients%5Bquery%5D=Chiu%20Ying-Nan&award_recipients%5BrefinementList%5D%5Byear%5D%5B0%5D=1986 |access-date=11 November 2024 |publisher=American Physical Society}}</ref> 

Ying-Nan Chiu was married to Lue Yung Chow.<ref>{{cite news |title=IN MEMORIAM: 1950s |url=https://magazine.berea.edu/wp-content/uploads/2020/05/80.4-2010-Spring.pdf |access-date=11 November 2024 |work=Berea College Magazine |date=Spring 2010 |page=41}}</ref> He died in [[Silver Spring, Maryland]], on 18 July 2009, aged 77.<ref name="asobit">{{cite news |title=Academician Ying-Nan Chiu Passed Away at Age 77 |url=https://newsletter.sinica.edu.tw/reviews/en/news/read_newscace.html |access-date=11 November 2024 |publisher=Academia Sinica |date=July 2009}} Republished {{in lang|zh}} {{cite news |title=丘應楠院士與世長辭 |url=https://newsletter.sinica.edu.tw/reviews/news/read_newsec37.html |access-date=11 November 2024 |publisher=Academia Sinica |date=July 2009}}</ref><ref name="yam"/>
